title: On The Hausdorff Dimension of Weighted Badly Approximable Vectors
summary: Let $\boldsymbolτ=(τ_1,\dots,τ_m)\in \mathbb{R}_{\ge 0}^m$ satisfy $\sum_{i=1}^m τ_i>1$ and $τ_1\ge \cdots \ge τ_m$ Let $Ψ_{\boldsymbolτ}=(ψ_1,\dots,ψ_m)$ be given by $$ ψ_i(q)=q^{-τ_i}, \qquad i=1,\dots,m,$$ and denote by $\mathcal{A}_m(Ψ_{\boldsymbolτ})$ the set of $Ψ_{\boldsymbolτ}$-approximable vectors in $[0,1]^m$. The associated set of weighted $Ψ_{\boldsymbolτ}$-badly approximable vectors is defined by $$\mathcal{B}_m(Ψ_{\boldsymbolτ}) = \mathcal{A}_m(Ψ_{\boldsymbolτ}) \setminus \bigcap_{0<c<1}\mathcal{A}_m(cΨ_{\boldsymbolτ}).$$ The main result of this paper is that, for every ball…
